panel.body: Click the button below to verify and unlock the rest of the server.

captcha.prompt: Type the characters from the image. It expires {time}.
captcha.title: Verification
captcha.label: Characters in the image

errors.notSetUp: Verification isn't set up yet. An admin needs to pick a verified or unverified role with /verification settings.
errors.tooNew: Your account is too new to verify here. Try again {time}.
errors.expired: That captcha expired. Click Verify again for a new one.
errors.wrong_one: That's not it. Here's a new image; {left} try left.
errors.wrong_other: That's not it. Here's a new image; {left} tries left.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong answers. Click Verify to start over.
errors.roles: I couldn't update your roles. Ask an admin to move my role above the verification roles.

command.settings: Choose the mode, roles and minimum account age
command.panel: Post the verify button in a channel

options.unverifiedRole: Role given on join and removed after verifying
options.minAccountDays: Accounts younger than this many days can't verify (0 = off)
options.channel: Where to post the verify button

command.title: Verification
command.footer: Hide your channels from @everyone or the unverified role, and show them to the verified role.

giveaways.entered: You're in! Good luck. Click the button again to leave.

announce.none: The giveaway for **{prize}** ended without anyone who qualified.

errors.duration: `{value}` doesn't work. Use a duration from 1 minute to 60 days, like `2d`.
errors.account_one: Your account must be at least {count} day old to enter.
errors.account_other: Your account must be at least {count} days old to enter.
errors.server_one: You must be in the server for at least {count} day to enter.
errors.server_other: You must be in the server for at least {count} days to enter.
errors.level: You need level {level} to enter. You're level {current}.

command.end: End a giveaway now and draw winners
command.reroll: Draw new winners for an ended giveaway

options.duration: How long it runs, like 1h, 2d or 1w
options.rerollWinners: How many new winners to draw (default 1)
options.requiredRole: Only members with this role can enter
options.bonusRole: A role that gets extra entries
options.bonusEntries: Extra entries for the bonus role (default 1)

options.idea: What you would like to see

manage.description: Respond to suggestions and configure them
manage.respond: Approve, deny, consider or mark a suggestion as implemented
manage.settings: Set the suggestion channel and options

options.threads: Open a discussion thread on each suggestion
options.dmAuthor: DM the author when staff respond

manage.saved: Suggestions go to {channel}. Threads: {threads}. DM on response: {dm}.

suggestions.dm: Your suggestion #{number} in **{server}** was marked as **{status}**.

setup.body: Members post ideas with {command} and vote on them with buttons. Staff respond with `/suggestion respond`.

errors.noChannel: Suggestions are not set up yet. An admin can pick a channel with `/suggestion settings` or `/setup`.
errors.closed: Voting on this suggestion has closed.

command.settings: Set the counting channel and rules
command.set: Set the current number, for example after a mistake
command.stats: Show the current number and the record

options.resetOnFail: Start over from 1 after a mistake
options.allowTwice: Let the same member count twice in a row

command.saved: Counting happens in {channel}. Reset on mistakes: {reset}. Same member twice: {twice}. Chat allowed: {chat}.

fail.wrongNumber: That's not the next number. It was **{next}**.
fail.twice: You can't count twice in a row.
fail.reset: {user} ruined it at **{count}**. {reason} Back to **1**. Record: **{record}**.

counting.deleted: {user} deleted their number **{count}**. The next number is **{next}**.

setup.body: Members count up one number at a time in this channel. More options with {command}.

command.settings: Set the starboard channel, emoji and threshold
command.ignore: Stop or resume picking up messages from a channel

options.channel: Channel where starred messages are posted
options.emoji: Reaction that counts as a star
options.threshold: Stars needed to reach the board
options.ignored: Channel to ignore or stop ignoring

command.saved: Starred messages go to {channel} after {threshold} {emoji}. Self-stars count: {self}.
command.ignored: Messages in {channel} won't reach the starboard anymore.
command.unignored: Messages in {channel} can reach the starboard again.

setup.body: Messages with **{threshold}** {emoji} reactions are reposted in the starboard channel. Change the emoji with {command}.

errors.emoji: That doesn't look like a single emoji. Use a normal emoji or a custom one from this server.

command.description: Keep a message at the bottom of this channel
command.set: Set or edit the sticky message in this channel
command.remove: Remove the sticky message from this channel
command.list: List the sticky messages in this server

sticky.label: Sticky message
sticky.saved: Sticky message saved. It moves back to the bottom whenever someone posts here.
sticky.empty: No sticky messages yet. Use `/sticky set` in a channel to add one.

errors.channel: I can't post in this channel.
errors.none: This channel has no sticky message.
errors.limit_one: This server already has the maximum of {count} sticky message.
errors.limit_other: This server already has the maximum of {count} sticky messages.

command.upcoming: The next birthdays in this server

options.year: Year, if you want your age in the announcement (only you can see it)
options.timezone: Your timezone, so the celebration starts at your midnight

admin.settings: Set the announcement channel, birthday role, timezone and message

options.role: Role members get for their birthday
options.timezone: Timezone for members who didn't pick one

admin.saved: Birthdays are announced in {channel} with the role {role}. Default timezone: {timeZone}.

announce.plain: Happy birthday, {user}! Everyone in **{server}** wishes you a great day.
announce.age: Happy birthday, {user}! You're turning **{age}** today. Everyone in **{server}** wishes you a great day.

birthdays.saved: Got it. Your birthday is saved as **{date}**.
birthdays.none: Nobody has saved a birthday yet. Use `/birthday set` to add yours.

setup.body: Members save their birthday with {command}. The default timezone is **{timeZone}**; change it and the message with {admin}.

errors.date: That date doesn't exist. Check the month, day and year.
errors.timeZone: I don't know that timezone. Pick one from the list, like `Europe/Berlin`.
errors.notSet: You haven't saved a birthday here.

command.description: Channels that show server counts in their name

options.name: Channel name; {count} is replaced with the number
options.category: Category to put the channel in

serverstats.added: Created {channel}. It updates every few minutes; Discord limits how often channels can be renamed.

errors.limit: A server can have up to 10 counters. Remove one first.
